title: Segmentation-Gated Face Recognition Configuration
description: Configuration schema for person segmentation gating and face parsing features

enable_person_gating.description: Enable person segmentation to gate face detection

model_path.description: Path to ONNX segmentation model file

interval.description: Frame interval for running segmentation (every N frames)

min_person_area.description: Minimum pixel area for valid person mask

expand_ratio.description: Expansion factor for person bounding boxes

max_rois_per_frame.description: Maximum ROIs to process per frame

enable_on_low_conf.description: Enable face parsing for low-confidence detections

low_conf_threshold.description: Confidence threshold below which to trigger parsing

min_skin_ratio.description: Minimum skin pixel ratio to accept face
